title.en: Aurora: the rough tone of a CW signal

concept.hr: Aurora u gibanju razmaže ton u šum širok stotine herca: Dopplerovo širenje
concept.en: A moving aurora smears a tone into a hiss hundreds of hertz wide: Doppler spread

summary.hr: Snimka aurora CW veze na 2 m sa spektrogramom: signal preko aurore razmazan je na oko 730 Hz, a vlastiti signal iste postaje je jedna čista crta.
summary.en: A recording of an aurora CW contact on 2 m with its spectrogram: the signal via the aurora is smeared over about 730 Hz, the own signal is one clean line.

what.hr: Aplet applet_aurora.html sa snimkom kraja CW veze između GM4YXI i OK/DF7TR/P preko aurore i njezinim prijepisom, te tekst odjeljaka o aurori (50ohm.de, aurora_1 i aurora_2, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_aurora.html with its recording of the end of a CW contact via the aurora between GM4YXI and OK/DF7TR/P and its transcript, and the text of the aurora sections (50ohm.de, aurora_1 and aurora_2, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, preveden na engleski, dodani spektrogram snimke i spektri izmjereni iz nje (signal preko aurore uz vlastiti signal)
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, translated into English, a spectrogram of the recording and spectra measured from it (the signal via the aurora next to the own signal) added
